#include "userdelfx.h"

// Effects link no oscillator API -- stand-ins for the two symbols primitives use.
#define osc_sinf fx_sinf
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) float osc_w0f_for_note(uint8_t note, uint8_t mod)
{
  const float f = 440.f * fastpow2f(((float)note + (float)mod * (1.f / 255.f) - 69.f) * (1.f / 12.f));
  return (f < 23679.643054f ? f : 23679.643054f) * (1.f / 48000.f);
}

// NOLOAD: the loader doesn't clear it, init() does.
static float s_sdram[8192] __sdram;

class Fx
{
public:
  void init()
  {
    sdram_n = s_sdram + 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8192u; ++i) s_sdram[i] = 0.f;
    note_ = 60.f;
    noteFine_ = 0.f;
    tempo_ = 120.f;
    time01_ = 0.f;
    depth01_ = 0.f;
    mix01_ = 0.f;
    w_n = 0u;
    timePercent_n = 40;
    gain_n = 50;
  }

  // Delay lines and state cleared, knob positions kept.
  void reset()
  {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8192u; ++i) sdram_n[i] = 0.f;
    w_n = 0u;
  }

  void setKnob(uint8_t index, float v)
  {
    switch (index)
    {
    case k_user_delfx_param_time: time01_ = v; break;
    case k_user_delfx_param_depth: depth01_ = v; break;
    case k_user_delfx_param_shift_depth: mix01_ = v; break;
    default: break;
    }
  }

  // Every input sample of a frame is read before its outputs are written: delay and reverb
  // units process in place.
  void process(const float *in, float *out, uint32_t frames)
  {
    (void)in;
    const float bpm = fx_get_bpmf();
    if (bpm > 0.f) tempo_ = bpm;
    const float blkAllpassDelay_n = (uint32_t)(clampf((0.5f + 99.5f * (timePercent_n) * (timePercent_n) * 0.0001f) * 48.f, 1.f, 8190.f) + 0.5f);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < frames; ++i)
    {
      float y_n = allpass_step_int(sdram_n, &w_n, blkAllpassDelay_n, 0.f, gain_n * 0.009f);
      out[2 * i] = clip1m1f(y_n);
      out[2 * i + 1] = clip1m1f(y_n);
    }
  }

private:
  // The note a primitive that follows the played note (an oscillator's pitch, a TRACK filter)
  // reads: an effect gets none, so it's a fixed middle C.
  float note_;
  float noteFine_;
  // The fixed knobs' positions (0..1), as the device reports them.
  float time01_;
  float depth01_;
  float mix01_;
  // The device tempo in BPM, 120 until the device gives one.
  float tempo_;
  float *sdram_n;
  uint32_t w_n;
  float timePercent_n;
  float gain_n;

  static float clampf(float v, float lo, float hi)
  {
    return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
  }

  // Schroeder allpass: w[n] = x + g*w[n-D], y = w[n-D] - g*w[n] -- a flat magnitude response
  // that smears an impulse into a decaying train (a reverb's diffusion). D is read with linear
  // interpolation, so a modulated time glides. What's stored is bounded (+-4) so a runaway input
  // can't grow without end. A leaf.
  static float allpass_step(float *buf, uint32_t *w, float delay, float x, float g)
  {
    const uint32_t di = (uint32_t)delay;
    const float frac = delay - (float)di;
    const float a = buf[(*w - di) & 8191u];
    const float b = buf[(*w - di - 1u) & 8191u];
    const float d = a + (b - a) * frac;
    float v = x + g * d;
    v = v > 4.f ? 4.f : (v < -4.f ? -4.f : v);
    buf[*w & 8191u] = v;
    *w = *w + 1u;
    return d - g * v;
  }

  static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) float allpass_step_int(float *buf, uint32_t *w, uint32_t di, float x, float g)
  {
    const float d = buf[(*w - di) & 8191u];
    float v = x + g * d;
    v = v > 4.f ? 4.f : (v < -4.f ? -4.f : v);
    buf[*w & 8191u] = v;
    *w = *w + 1u;
    return d - g * v;
  }
};

static Fx s_fx;

void DELFX_INIT(uint32_t platform, uint32_t api)
{
  (void)platform;
  (void)api;
  s_fx.init();
}

void DELFX_PROCESS(float *xn, uint32_t frames) { s_fx.process(xn, xn, frames); }

void DELFX_SUSPEND(void) {}

// Cleared on resume as well, so a unit switched back in never replays a stale line.
void DELFX_RESUME(void) { s_fx.reset(); }

// Q31 (0..2^31-1, 10 bits of it real), not 0..1023 (the phase 0 spike, on a real xd).
void DELFX_PARAM(uint8_t index, int32_t value) { s_fx.setKnob(index, clip01f(q31_to_f32(value))); }
